texts.zh:
[From.GetAdjective]的轻微异动是一切的开端。我们收到了零星的情报，尽管之前仅在自己的空间内活动，他们的舰队现在已经开始向星系内遥远的众恒星系开动。异常先进的侦察舰开始探访那些古老的、被毁掉的星球，并对任何向他们打招呼或者回避的舰船发动攻击。现在，他们的目的和使命已经昭然若揭了。

我们现在知道[From.GetSpeciesName]已经整装待发，他们恢复了调查信标的数据链，并重新启用了那些在他们退缩到目前边境之时废弃的侦察哨站。情报显示，他们的意图是重新回到星系这张大棋盘上。

在[From.GetSpeciesName]空间，舰队正在集结，军队已经下达了征召令，那些古老的工厂再一次发出轰鸣声。几百年来第一次，[From.GetName]开始将他们的目光投注到边境线外广大的星系。

破败的船坞再一次得到修复与调整，一度沉寂的泰坦巨舰铸造厂重新上线。整个星系都在关注同一个问题：当这位一度沉睡的巨人决定恢复旧日荣光时，谁会成为第一个螳臂当车的宵小呢？
texts.en:
It began as a subtle shift in [From.GetAdjective] behavior. Scattered reports of their ships, once rarely seen outside their own space, now being spotted in remote systems all across the galaxy. Highly advanced scouting vessels visiting ancient, ruined worlds, refusing all hails and fleeing when attacked. Their purpose and mission unknown... until now.

We now know that the [From.GetSpeciesName] were preparing, recovering the databanks of survey beacons and automated scouting posts left behind when they retreated to their present borders. Gathering information for their return to the galactic stage.

In [From.GetSpeciesName] space, fleets are gathering, armies are being mustered and ancient factories roar to life. For the first time in an age, the [From.GetName] are looking outwards beyond their borders and towards the galaxy at large.

As their decaying shipyards are repaired and refitted and the dormant systems of Titan foundries come online, the rest of the galaxy is left with only one question - who will this once-sleeping giant target first in their quest to reclaim age-old glory lost?

summary.text:
# 圣地 / Holy World

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/planet_destruction_events.txt:1635-1873; common/on_actions/01_planet_destruction.txt:20,41,126,149,198; events/toxoids_events.txt:380-413; events/colony_events_1.txt:4598; events/fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:143 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

毁坏、屏蔽或淹没一颗“圣地”（holy_planet 修正），或把圣地改成墓地世界（toxoids.50），而某个信仰圣地的堕落帝国（AI 性格 holy_planets，未觉醒）与施放者没有交战时，隐藏事件 planet_destruction.600/605/607（或 toxoids.50）选一个“被激怒的堕落帝国”，5天后给施放者 planet_destruction.610（淹没则 .615）。

Fragging, shielding or flooding a holy world (holy_planet modifier), or terraforming one into a tomb world (toxoids.50), while a holy-world fallen empire (AI personality holy_planets, not awakened) is not at war with the perpetrator: hidden planet_destruction.600/605/607 (or toxoids.50) pick an outraged fallen empire and, 5 days later, show planet_destruction.610 (planet_destruction.615 for a flood) to the perpetrator.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

窗口 610/615 按施放者的伦理/文明显示不同选项（灵性、唯物、军国……、集群、吞噬蜂群、终结者、净化者），选项本身无效果；其 after 块设置 holy_world_killed 并向该堕落帝国触发 fallen_empires_awakening.1，使其苏醒（fallen_empires_awakening.1 令所有玩家收到“睡狮的苏醒”fallen_empires_awakening.2，并在5天后由 planet_destruction.611 宣战，战争名为“…圣地之战”，战争目标为征服，events/fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:138-144）。后续见“睡狮的苏醒”等堕落帝国觉醒故事。

Windows 610/615 offer options by the perpetrator's ethic or civic (spiritualist, materialist, militarist ... gestalt, devouring swarm, terminator, purifier); the options themselves have no effect. Its after block sets holy_world_killed and fires fallen_empires_awakening.1 at that fallen empire, which awakens (every player gets fallen_empires_awakening.2 "Sleepers Awake" and 5 days later planet_destruction.611 declares the "... Holy World War" with a subjugation war goal, events/fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:138-144). Continues in the fallen-empire awakening stories.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

本导读未单列条件差异；条件随各事件在上文说明，阅读器按文明设定显示可能的版本。/ This guide does not list conditions separately; they are described with each event above, and the reader shows the possible variants for the chosen empire profile.
